definitions.explanation: The manager in charge of a department or division in a company.

examples.japanese: {部長|ぶちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{報告|ほうこく}→報告：03618_houkoku⟧⟦しました→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I reported to the department head.

examples.japanese: ⟦{山田|やまだ}→山田：09529_yamada⟧{部長|ぶちょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{公平|こうへい}→公平：01648_kouhei⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: Manager Yamada is strict but fair.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来年|らいねん}→来年：00745_rainen⟧{部長|ぶちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{昇進|しょうしん}→昇進：04553_shoushin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦かもしれません→かもしれない：00164_kamoshirenai⟧。
examples.english: I might be promoted to department head next year.

notes:
{部長|ぶちょう} means department/division head. Composed of ⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧ (department) + ⟦{長|ちょう}→〜長：04665_chou⟧ (chief/head).

CORPORATE HIERARCHY (typical):
- ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧: president/CEO
- ⟦{専務|せんむ}→専務：19291_senmu⟧: executive director
- ⟦{常務|じょうむ}→常務：27575_joumu⟧: managing director
- {部長|ぶちょう}: department head
- ⟦{課長|かちょう}→課長：01075_kachou⟧: section chief
- ⟦{係長|かかりちょう}→係長：08212_kakarichou⟧: supervisor
- ⟦{主任|しゅにん}→主任：08211_shunin⟧: senior staff

USAGE AS TITLE:
⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧ + {部長|ぶちょう}: used to address or refer to the person
- ⟦{山田|やまだ}→山田：09529_yamada⟧{部長|ぶちょう}: Department Head Yamada

IN SCHOOL CLUBS:
{部長|ぶちょう} = club president/captain
- ⟦{野球|やきゅう}→野球：04727_yakyuu⟧⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{部長|ぶちょう}: baseball team captain
